from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u094/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != 5 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                rr, cc = stack.pop()
                cells.append((rr, cc))
                for nr, nc in ((rr-1, cc), (rr+1, cc), (rr, cc-1), (rr, cc+1)):
                    if 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and grid[nr][nc] == 5 and (nr, nc) not in seen:
                        seen.add((nr, nc))
                        stack.append((nr, nc))
            top = min(rr for rr, _ in cells)
            bottom = max(rr for rr, _ in cells)
            left = min(cc for _, cc in cells)
            right = max(cc for _, cc in cells)
            top_cols = {cc for rr, cc in cells if rr == top}
            gaps = [cc for cc in range(left + 1, right) if cc not in top_cols]
            if len(gaps) != 1:
                continue
            gap = gaps[0]
            left_count = sum(cc < gap for cc in top_cols)
            right_count = sum(cc > gap for cc in top_cols)
            direction = -1 if left_count > right_count else 1
            for rr in range(top + 1, bottom):
                for cc in range(left + 1, right):
                    if out[rr][cc] == 0:
                        out[rr][cc] = 2
            out[top][gap] = 2
            if top > 0:
                cols = range(gap, -1, -1) if direction < 0 else range(gap, w)
                for cc in cols:
                    out[top - 1][cc] = 2
    return out
'''
p=programs/'task-5ed55c30.py'
p.write_text(code)
